_comment: Self-play (non-replay) run registry. One entry per kept lineage (combined continuations by champion base ModelID). selfplay.py parses [STATS] lines from `logs` (chronological) into data/<key>.csv using the SAME schema as the replay tracker. cum_step = the [STATS] steps= value (already cumulative across a lineage's launches; backward rewinds on resume are deduped last-writer-wins). `log_kept_to` {log: last raw step on the kept chain} drops the tail of a launch that a later launch of the chain resumed from an earlier save of (that tail was trained on weights the resume threw away; its rows would otherwise stay interleaved with the kept chain, since the two branches' [STATS] ticks rarely land on the same step). `excluded_logs` {log: reason} records launches deliberately NOT parsed: whole abandoned branches, diverged resumes, and other experiments' forks that load this lineage's weights. Neither field is inferred: each value was read off the logs' `[CHECKPOINT] Loaded session` / `Saved session` lines and first [STATS] step. elapsed_train_sec sums each launch's own elapsed= (approximate; by-step charts are authoritative). pElo/nll come from the in-training WIDE (4,435-pos) lichess probe curve in selfplay_probe/<key>.csv when one exists, merged onto the [STATS] row of each 1000-step bucket; runs that predate the probe carry the manual endpoint_pElo/endpoint_nll on the final row only. Self-play has no per-1000-step frozen checkpoints, so there is nothing else to probe after the fact. type=selfplay distinguishes these from corpus-replay runs.

Ejp0r1.arch_blocks: v5 pre · 2×[15×15+15×15 @64, SE+/4, clean_add, ReZero(0.5), out:layer_norm]
Ejp0r1.note: Run 1 of the Ejp0 self-play fork (session orSA), 2026-08-06 21:53 → 2026-08-08 17:40, ENDED by user after a 27-arena parity stall (arenas #117-#143 after the last promotion, #116). Seeded from the qeu8 corpus-replay checkpoint meta 1300000 (pElo 1731). lr-cycling and momentum-cycling OFF in segments 0-2, ON from 13:15:36 on 08-07 in segment 3 (first `·cyc` [STATS] at step 44,658, before the first promotion; 1,669 of segment 3's 1,796 [STATS] lines). Segments 0-2 each restarted the step counter from 1 (concatenated); segment 3 resumed segment 2's 44,113 periodic save (20260807-151717), so segment 2's 44,113-59,717 tail is an abandoned branch and is cut (log_kept_to). The by-STEP axis is the authoritative one. pElo/nll here are the in-app WIDE (4,435-pos) lichess probe on the recording build's scale; the narrow 200-pos probe in the same logs reads ~60-120 HIGHER and is not what is tracked. The probe scores argmax top-1 and is blind to policy diffuseness, so it can disagree with the sampled arena by construction (established 2026-08-07: soft self-play sampling diffuses the trainer's policy, the arena samples that policy, and the argmax probe cannot see the difference).

Ejp0.note: Run 2 of the Ejp0 self-play fork (session sjIy), 2026-08-08 17:40 → 2026-08-30 14:11, STOPPED by user (Stop button, paused for a macOS update), then RESUMED once on 2026-09-17 17:02 → 19:02 (build 2105, still the near-greedy τ 0.2→0.01) from the 08-30 13:59 post-promotion save of Ejp0-66 at step 1,183,795 (the 08-30 log's 1,183,795-1,184,817 tail is cut). That resume ran arenas #929-#935 and promoted once (#930, +21, step 1,186,322 → champion Ejp0-67, saved as 20260917-223317-…-sjIy-promote); it ended at step 1,192,765 with trainer Ejp0-68. 67 promotions, but only the first 41 (through step ~959,500) were measured under the arena schedule τ 0.6→0.2 with 399-400/400-unique arenas: at 2026-08-28 19:12 both self-play and arena τ were set to 0.2→0.01, arena game diversity fell to as low as 64/400 unique, and the remaining 26 promotions (Ejp0-42..-66 in ~43h to 08-30, plus Ejp0-67 on 09-17) were scored by that degraded instrument. Started as a FRESH fork from the same qeu8 meta-1300000 seed as run1 — NOT a continuation of run1, which is why the two are separate runs here. Both runs used lr + momentum cycling (run 1 from its segment 3 on), so cycling is not what separates them. Segments 1-3 are resumes (step counter continues), so the cumulative step axis is exact; each earlier launch is cut at the step the next one resumed from (log_kept_to). pElo/nll here are the in-app WIDE (4,435-pos) lichess probe on the recording build's scale; the narrow 200-pos probe in the same logs reads ~60-120 HIGHER and is not what is tracked. The probe scores argmax top-1 and is blind to policy diffuseness, so it can disagree with the sampled arena by construction (established 2026-08-07: soft self-play sampling diffuses the trainer's policy, the arena samples that policy, and the argmax probe cannot see the difference).
